AR203
Becoming Human
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
Where did we come from? What makes us human? This
course
examines the latest research on our evolutionary past, through an exploration of our primate and hominid relatives, how they lived, and how we became the creative/inventive, complex thinking humans that we are today.
Additional Course Information
Exclusions
AN102, AR103.
